text: ANDREY ROOT-CAUSE: installed CLI is GLOBAL (~/.codeterm/bin); a worker ./build.sh cli rebuilt it and its socket-discovery now resolves to a DIFFERENT instance (batchtest), so orchestrator 'codeterm plan record' hit the wrong daemon. FIX: CLI per-dev-instance location OR strictly honor CODETERM_API_PORT/CODETERM_INSTANCE in socket-discovery so rebuilding one dev CLI never hijacks another. Sibling of the isolated-dev-in-worktree task. Workaround: dogfood via curl to the right port.

CONFIRMED by BE independently: CODETERM_INSTANCE/CODETERM_API_PORT alone do NOT redirect the CLI — socket-discovery picks a stale/other instance socket unless CODETERM_DATA_DIR or CODETERM_SOCKET_PATH is EXPLICIT. WORKAROUND (works): CODETERM_SOCKET_PATH=/tmp/codeterm-dev-<instance>.sock (main dev = /tmp/codeterm-dev.sock). FIX: socket-discovery must derive the socket path from CODETERM_INSTANCE (and CODETERM_API_PORT) deterministically, so each dev's CLI targets its own daemon without manual CODETERM_SOCKET_PATH.

CLI now derives /tmp/codeterm-dev-handoff.sock from CODETERM_INSTANCE=handoff and reads ~/.codeterm-dev-handoff config before inherited prod tokens; verified capabilities and pane new against isolated 7691 without CODETERM_SOCKET_PATH.

CLI socket-discovery FIX shipped in 5efb622a (cli/src/client.rs) — CLI now resolves the right instance from CODETERM_API_PORT/CODETERM_INSTANCE without a manual CODETERM_SOCKET_PATH override (override kept as escape hatch).
